# kener_maintenance (Data Source)

Fetches a single Kener maintenance window by its numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kener_maintenance" "weekly" {
  id = "5"
}

output "maintenance_url" {
  value = data.kener_maintenance.weekly.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the maintenance.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `duration_seconds` (Number) Duration of each occurrence (seconds).
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors affected by this maintenance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `rrule` (String) Recurrence rule (RRULE).
- `start_date_time` (Number) Start time (Unix seconds).
- `status` (String) Whether the maintenance is enabled.
- `title` (String) Maintenance title.
- `url` (String) Absolute public URL.

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `impact` (String) Impact level.
- `monitor_tag` (String) Affected monitor tag.
